title: Dear Comrade
desc: Bobby, a student union leader with anger issues, falls in love with Lilly, a state-level cricketer. However, his temperament poses an obstacle in his path to be with her.

title: Oh Manapenne
desc: Karthik, an unmotivated graduate and Shruthi, an ambitious entrepreneur, team up to start a food truck, facing challenges that bring them closer.

title: Max
desc: Max, a military dog, returns to the United States after a traumatic experience in Afghanistan. However, his handler's family adopt him and strive to help him recover.

title: Yamakaathaghi
desc: After the demise of a young woman, her spirit remains inside her funeral home and refuses to leave. Soon, her death leads to a disturbing supernatural investigation.

title: Manjummel Boys
desc: After one of them falls inside a dangerous pit in the Guna Caves, a group of childhood friends muster courage to rescue him out of a space from where a return is next to impossible.

title: Aruvam
desc: A woman with anosmia experiences paranormal events and soon finds herself involved in a series of mysterious murders linked to food adulteration.

title: Pugaipadam
desc: A group of college friends welcome Shiny into their circle. Soon, Krishna from the group and Shiny fall in love with each other but decide to keep it a secret.

title: Katrathu Kalavu
desc: A boy and a girl, who want to earn quick money, meet and decide to con people for a living. Things change when a politician that they are blackmailing decides to settle scores.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Jaya Janaki Nayaka
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: Maanaadu
desc: A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.

title: Tourist Family
desc: After the COVID-19 pandemic hits Sri Lanka, a family travels to India to begin a new life. Their arrival quickly transforms their new neighbourhood.

title: Thuppakki
desc: An army officer sets out to save the people of his country when he learns that an entire network of terrorists are operating in the city and are planning to carry out multiple terror attacks.

title: Lubber Pandhu
desc: Anbu faces opposition as he joins a local cricket team. His rivalry with Gethu, a veteran player, creates tension that challenges their ambitions and relationships.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.
